# Ledger Transaction

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:LedgerTransaction`](gmeow-LedgerTransaction.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/LedgerTransaction>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/attestation`](../../slices/attestation.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A transaction recorded on a distributed ledger or blockchain — the information-object representation of the payload, not the on-chain bytes themselves.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:LedgerTransaction`](gmeow-LedgerTransaction.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to model a ledger or blockchain transaction as evidence backing an attestation — the information-object view of the payload, when its hash, finality, and confirmation depth matter.

### Avoid when

- Avoid reading ledger inclusion as real-world truth — blockchain inclusion proves ledger inclusion under chain rules, NOT correctness (module boundaries) — and avoid it for the raw on-chain bytes or for transparency-log evidence ([`gmeow:TransparencyLogEntry`](gmeow-TransparencyLogEntry.md)).

### How to use

- Mint the transaction with [`gmeow:transactionHash`](../properties/gmeow-transactionHash.md) (the EL minimum), record [`gmeow:finalityStatus`](../properties/gmeow-finalityStatus.md), [`gmeow:confirmationDepth`](../properties/gmeow-confirmationDepth.md), and [`gmeow:ledgerInclusionProof`](../properties/gmeow-ledgerInclusionProof.md), and locate it on its [`gmeow:BlockchainNetwork`](gmeow-BlockchainNetwork.md) / [`gmeow:Block`](gmeow-Block.md); chain-finality checks run in the solver layer ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

### Examples

- ex:tx1 a [`gmeow:LedgerTransaction`](gmeow-LedgerTransaction.md); [`gmeow:transactionHash`](../properties/gmeow-transactionHash.md) "0xabc..."; [`gmeow:finalityStatus`](../properties/gmeow-finalityStatus.md) [`gmeow:finalityStatusFinalized`](../individuals/gmeow-finalityStatusFinalized.md).
